name: hyvision-one
description: Hyvision One - Integrated ERP for Hyvision India

scripts.start:railway: echo 'This is a monorepo root. Please deploy hvo-server or hvo-frontend services separately.' && exit 1
scripts.stop: powershell -Command "Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; netstat -ano | Select-String ':3030.*LISTENING|:5030.*LISTENING' | ForEach-Object { ($_.Line -split '\s+')[-1] } | Select-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'All servers stopped' -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.build: cd hvo-server && npm install && npm run build && cd ../hvo-frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:ci: cd hvo-server && npm install && npm run build && cd ../hvo-frontend && npm install && npm run build:ci
scripts.lint: cd hvo-server && npm run lint && cd ../hvo-frontend && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd hvo-server && npm run lint:fix && cd ../hvo-frontend && npm run lint:fix
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules, hvo-server/node_modules, hvo-frontend/node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Cleaned' -ForegroundColor Green"

author: Hyvision One Team
